answer: AI-agent grids tracking river levels or sable sightings at dawn can resist Sybil attacks via zero-knowledge passport nullifiers. At registration, an operator proves an ICAO-signed NFC passport in a ZK-SNARK, yielding a scoped nullifier for one key to block duplicates without leaking PII. This forces attackers to source scarce physical passports per identity instead of cloning keys. Still, users without NFC passports face exclusion, and bribed holders can lease credentials.
